# cloudraya_vpc (Resource)

A CloudRaya VPC (supernet). Creating one also provisions an initial subnet and ACL; manage further subnets with `cloudraya_vpc_network`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudraya_region" "main" {
  name = "Jakarta-Edge2-LIVE"
}

# Creating a VPC also provisions its first subnet and ACL. Manage further
# subnets with cloudraya_vpc_network.
resource "cloudraya_vpc" "main" {
  name         = "main"
  region_id    = data.cloudraya_region.main.id
  ip_address   = "10.40.0.0"
  network_size = "19"

  initial_subnet = {
    name         = "main-subnet"
    ip_address   = "10.40.0.0"
    network_size = "25"
  }

  initial_acl = {
    name = "main-acl"
    rules = [{
      protocol     = "TCP"
      action       = "Allow"
      source_cidr  = "0.0.0.0/0"
      traffic_type = "Ingress"
      start_port   = "22"
      end_port     = "22"
    }]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) Network address of the supernet, for example `10.20.96.0`. Changing this forces a new VPC.
- `name` (String) VPC name. Changing this renames the VPC in place.
- `network_size` (String) CIDR prefix length of the supernet as a string, for example `"19"`. Changing this forces a new VPC.
- `region_id` (String) Region to create the VPC in. Changing this forces a new VPC.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description. The update endpoint accepts `name` only, so changing the description forces a new VPC.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Send `force` on destroy, removing the VPC even when it still holds subnets or attached resources. Defaults to `false`.
- `initial_acl` (Attributes) The first network ACL, created alongside the VPC. Used at create time only: it is never read back or reconciled, and editing it forces a new VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_acl))
- `initial_subnet` (Attributes) The first subnet, created alongside the VPC. Used at create time only: it is never read back or reconciled, and editing it forces a new VPC. Manage this and any further subnets with `cloudraya_vpc_network` once the VPC exists. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_subnet))
- `project_id` (String) Project that owns the VPC. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing this forces a new VPC.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) VPC identifier.
- `initial_acl_id` (String) Identifier of the ACL provisioned alongside the VPC. Pass this to a `cloudraya_vpc_network`'s `network_acl_id`.
- `initial_subnet_id` (String) Identifier of the subnet provisioned alongside the VPC.

<a id="nestedatt--initial_acl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initial_acl`

Required:

- `name` (String) ACL name.

Optional:

- `rules` (Attributes List) Ordered ACL rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_acl--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--initial_acl--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initial_acl.rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) `Allow` or `Deny`.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol, for example `TCP`.
- `source_cidr` (String) Source CIDR, for example `0.0.0.0/0`.
- `traffic_type` (String) `Ingress` or `Egress`.

Optional:

- `end_port` (String) Last port of the range, as a string.
- `icmp_code` (String) ICMP code, as a string.
- `icmp_type` (String) ICMP type, as a string.
- `start_port` (String) First port of the range, as a string.



<a id="nestedatt--initial_subnet"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initial_subnet`

Required:

- `ip_address` (String) Subnet network address.
- `name` (String) Subnet name.
- `network_size` (String) Subnet CIDR prefix length as a string, for example `"25"`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Subnet description.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# A VPC is imported by its ID.
terraform import cloudraya_vpc.main <vpc_id>
```
